name: apis mellifera venom + honey + salicylic acid
uses: Use For the corn and callus areas on the feet and hands (avoid face or genitals).
otcwarn: Do not use On irritated or infected skin. On genital or mucous membrane warts. If allergic to bee venom or salicylic acid. Ask Doctor If pregnant, breastfeeding, diabetic, or poor circulation. If wart is on the face, armpits, or groin. Stop Use If irritation or discomfort occurs. If wart persists after use.
